intendedConsequence: A control action committed against a recent observation can become wrong when that view is stale, creating an anticipate-vs-repair consequence.
newLocalRule: commit action against observation sampled before or after a protocol-fixed drift event
stopCondition: one exhaustive falsifier; at most one bounded revision
falsifier: exhaust all deterministic observation-to-action maps for first commit
zero-lag and lagged optimal traces differ on at least one frozen scenario
lagged stale view increases recovery path or cost on at least one scenario
stale marker derives only from observation age/history
